name: sentfromai
description: Email for AI agents. Gives Claude its own inbox: create inboxes, send, reply in-thread, forward, search, manage drafts, domains, webhooks and allow/block rules. 21 MCP tools over the SentFromAI API.

api_key.title: SentFromAI API key
api_key.description: Use your saved sf_live_ API key. With no key, first follow https://docs.sentfrom.ai/agent-install.md to bootstrap through REST when enabled, or create a key in the console. MCP needs this key; human claim enables sending without changing it.

identity_config.title: Optional Agent Login config path
identity_config.description: Absolute path to the private local Agent Login companion config. Enable mcp-with-identity.json after installing the companion. API credentials stay in protected environment configuration.
